title: smime-tree: implement encrypt()
description:
Encryption is a core S/MIME operation. Implement in encrypt.rs: generate random CEK and IV; encrypt content; wrap CEK per recipient; build EnvelopedData; encode as ContentInfo DER; wrap in application/pkcs7-mime MIME. RFC texts in ~/PROJECT/MIME/standards/.

Do NOT hand-roll any of this:
- Random generation: rand_core::OsRng (NOT the top-level rand crate — rand_core is the minimal CSPRNG interface; OsRng satisfies CryptoRngCore which all RustCrypto primitives accept)
- Content encryption: aes+cbc for AES-CBC; aes-gcm for AES-GCM
- RSA path (KeyTransRecipientInfo): rsa crate OAEP or PKCS1v15 key transport
- ECDH path (KeyAgreeRecipientInfo, RFC 5753): p256/p384 ephemeral key pair; x963-kdf for KDF; aes-kw to wrap CEK
- DER encoding of EnvelopedData: cms crate builder types + der crate encoding traits — do not hand-roll DER
acceptance_criteria: encrypt() output is decrypted correctly by openssl smime -decrypt for both RSA and ECDH recipient certs
